name: doks
description: Minimalist AI agent plugin and document keeper that scaffolds, audits, and maintains a topic-driven, mutable /docs knowledge base (architecture, decisions, pending, requisites, and history) with summary.md indexers.
suggestedPrompts: /doks-init Initialize the Doks /docs knowledge base in this project
/doks-sync Record recent architectural decisions and update summary.md and history logs
/doks-audit Audit /docs for summary.md coverage, character limits, and timestamp compliance
